title: FTC Act Section 5 — Unfair or deceptive acts or practices, as applied to AI
description: The FTC's general unfairness/deception authority, as applied to AI/algorithmic harms in enforcement actions such as the Rite Aid facial-recognition case. Paraphrase pending verification against primary FTC sources — hence 'Community' confidence.
control_text: Prohibits unfair or deceptive acts or practices in commerce. The FTC has applied this authority to AI/algorithmic harms — for example, alleging that a company's failure to implement reasonable safeguards around a facial-recognition surveillance system that produced disproportionate false-match harms against protected groups constituted an unfair act or practice.

citations.title: Aiming for truth, fairness, and equity in your company's use of AI
citations.publisher: Federal Trade Commission, Business Guidance Blog

citations.title: Rite Aid Banned from Using AI Facial Recognition After FTC Says Retailer Deployed Technology without Reasonable Safeguards

relationships.reason: Satisfying this control requires documented evidence that reasonable accuracy and human-review safeguards were in place.
